svg.aria-label: System architecture. An Orchestrator drives an Intake Agent and a Communication Agent. Each external service (Gmail, Retell, Rocketlane, Claude, Slack) sits behind one adapter. Deterministic guardrails decide what to trust from Claude, and an Escalator reaches the CS Manager by email and Slack.
svg.title: NovaCRM onboarding agents: system architecture

reads it back, needs a yes

Looks for the project before re-POST

text.tspan: uv run novacrm watch | once | resume

svg.text: Channel name, topic and purpose by tier
Welcome: Claude draft, else static template
4. comm.run(OnboardingHandoff): deal + confirmed tier + project. The agents never call each other.
Emails the CS Manager: run ID, reason, transcript
Asks the AE on the thread instead of guessing
post_message to #cs-escalations. Best effort: the email has already gone out, so a Slack failure never blocks it.
SQLite. One row per email: state, tier, project, channel, attempts
message_id is UNIQUE: the idempotency key
Append-only: time, input, output, decision, rationale
Phone numbers masked. novacrm show <run> prints the timeline
Tier to template, days, CSM model; AE directory; CSM roster
Template and CSM come from here, never from the LLM
